media:group.media:description:
Mckenna Grace just took method dressing to a new level. The actress channeled Jennifer Lawrence’s Katniss Everdeen in a Monique Lhuillier gown inspired by the iconic wedding dress from “The Hunger Games: Catching Fire.”
Grace was joined by her “The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping” costar Joseph Zada at the Panem exhibition in Paris.

entry.title: The Trends That Defined Milan Fashion Week

media:group.media:title: The Trends That Defined Milan Fashion Week
media:group.media:description:
Elegant femininity, Italian maximalism and a renewed sense of joy shaped the runways at Milan Fashion Week. The bra emerged as the natural companion to the skirt, blurring the lines between underwear and outerwear, while 3D embellishments and pastel shades made a major statement.
